content: Ekaterina Mizulina, head of Russia's Safe Internet League(Image: Ekaterina Mizulina / East2west news) Russian brute President Vladimir Putin has reportedly found new love with a London-educated art historian, according to new claims. Ekaterina ‘Katya’ Mizulina, 39, is the head of Russia’s Safe Internet League and the daughter of a fanatically pro-Putin and anti-Ukrainian senator. She is seen as a web censor, seeking to stamp out criticism of the dictator, especially on the war against Ukraine. Social media outlets in Russia and Ukraine have seized on claims that the 71-year-old warmonger has found a new confidante in the hardline Mizulina, daughter of Senator Elena Mizulina, 69.‌‌ Mizulina graduated from the School of Oriental and African Studies at the University of London in 2004 and has a degree in art history and Indonesian language. She has worked as a translator in official Russian delegations visiting China and her philosopher father Professor Mikhail Mizulin, 69, is a leading academic in Moscow. She once said: "First, we will clean up Ukraine from the Nazis and bandits, and then we will get to Google and Wikipedia." Vladimir Putin with Alina Kabaeva - who he has been previously linked with(Image: Kremlin.ru/e2w) Russian human rights campaigner Olga Romanova, an expert in the prison system in which opposition leader Alexei Navalny died on Friday, told Ukraine’s Channel 24: "Katya Mizulina is completely to Putin’s taste. This Barbie  [type] has always suited him very well." Local media also says they have "become close." More info Romanov likened her to an earlier Putin lover, Svetlana Krivonogikh, a striptease club owner and multimillionaire in St Petersburg and allegedly the mother of Putin's love child Luiza, 20. Olga said: "[Putin is] 71 years old, let's not be ageist. In general, the man is in full bloom, why not? And, in fact, Katya Mizulina, after all, she is 39... Let’s also not forget…she is for traditional values. Just like, [Putin’s long-time partner] Alina Kabaeva [It looks like he told his press secretary] another harem [member] met me and fell in love with me." ‌Ukrainian Focus media said: "Russian insiders claim that Ekaterina Mizulina has the type of appearance that particularly attracts Vladimir Putin." At a meeting with students this month, she demanded - and received - an apology from a student who had questioned the need for compulsory military service. She reportedly threatened him with Putin’s draconian laws on discrediting the Russian army.
